children: Amesite Inc. reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $364777 and a net loss of $3095838 with diluted loss per share of $(0.63). Revenue increased from $110459 a year earlier, while the net loss narrowed versus FY 2025.
Revenue was $364777, compared with $110459 in the prior year; YoY change 230.3%.
Net income was $(3,095,838), compared with $(3,617,086) in the prior year; YoY change 14.4%.
Diluted EPS was $(0.63), compared with $(1.03) in the prior year; YoY change 38.8%.
Revenue growth was driven primarily by B2B license fees for NurseMagic™, lifting FY 2026 sales to $364.8K from $110.5K in FY 2025.
Management continued a strategic shift from higher education toward healthcare, refocusing development and sales efforts on NurseMagic™ AI tools.
Operating efficiency improved through reduced payroll and advertising spending, helping narrow the net loss by about $521K year over year.
The company continued to capitalize software development costs (amortized over three years) and prioritized AI feature development for immediate market impact.
Management noted liquidity and going-concern uncertainty and is pursuing equity financings to fund ongoing operations.
